name: LDS Church News
tagline: Watches official Latter-day Saint announcements and stays quiet until something matters
description: A quiet monitor over two official feeds: the church's Newsroom page and its Church News publication. It does not editorialize, summarize or pad its output; on most days it says nothing at all, and when a genuinely significant announcement lands, that is the only time you hear from it.
author: londontodd
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
